title: ProbeResult
description: Record produced by the Loomora application in probe mode (one ASCII JSON line). Each UI writes it to standard output, a file or the system log depending on the family.

ui_variant.description: Which UI implementation produced the record.

input.description: Text given to the greeting function (the default "Coucou" in probe mode).

greeting_matches.description: True if message equals "Bonjour " + input as computed by the backend.

core.description: cpp = native; cpp-wasm = WebAssembly; cpp-js = JavaScript fallback (Emscripten without WebAssembly).

compiler.description: Compiler that built the backend, from loomora_build_compiler(), e.g. gcc 8.3.0, clang 17.0.6, emscripten 1.39.20.

displayed.description: True if the window/screen was drawn without error.

display_ms.description: Delay from launch to first display, in milliseconds.

peak_rss_kb.description: Peak resident memory, null if not measurable.

disabled_features.description: Features disabled in this UI on this platform (empty if none).
